about: Assets of PAE-02 SCION 14 (Pose2Pose casting). Nothing fetched from the web; no generated images.

assets.what: reference footage (looked at, not shown)
assets.operation: looked at in contact sheets (frames 0-48) to set the dog's build and markings (dark saddle, pale ring of ruff, pale legs, pricked ears) and to see how this dog turns round (through a front view, head leading). No pixels, masks or rig keys from the footage are used in any drawing.
